title: Points Earned on a Paid Repair Order — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Rewards Computation
content:
## Which repair order
The paid repair order, whose points are being credited, is the repair order of the latest payment received on the account, and its vehicle is the vehicle on its labor charges. Wherever a record is chosen as the latest of its kind and two such records share that date, the one listed first in the records counts. Where no payment has been received on the account there is no paid repair order and no points are credited.

## Paid in full
The paid repair order is paid in full when its charges, customer-pay and deductible alike, less every credit on it, less the payments received on it, plus any payment returned on it, come to zero or less, and a repair order not paid in full earns no points. A repair order whose customer-pay labor charges, less the estimate overage, comeback, goodwill and rewards redemption credits standing on it, come to less than one dollar earns no points.

## The points
- *Paid labor and parts total*: the paid repair order's customer-pay labor and parts charges less the estimate overage, comeback and goodwill credits standing on that repair order.
- *Earning rate*: the tier's points per dollar in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders points terms.
- *Earning dollars*: the paid labor and parts total with the cents dropped.
- The points credited for the paid repair order are the earning rate times the earning dollars, never more than the tier's most points per repair order.

## Assembly
The points are assembled in this order: first the earning rate is applied to the earning dollars, every per-dollar labor bonus this policy sets out is applied to the whole dollars of customer-pay labor charged on the paid repair order, and the two are added; then every multiplier this policy sets out is applied to that sum and the fraction is dropped; then every fixed number of points this policy sets out is added; and the total is held to the tier's most points per repair order.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)
Customer-pay labor 512.40 and parts 233.85, an estimate overage credit of 21.60, every charge paid: the paid labor and parts total is 724.65, the earning dollars 724, and at a hypothetical 2 points per dollar with a 10000-point cap the points are 1448. Had a 60.00 deductible on the same repair order been left unpaid, the repair order would not be paid in full and would earn no points.
